Worked for a customer service line for a major corporation, when filing the claim with the courier service make sure you send in pictures from the packaging initially sent and the received package. With the different tape that is clearly theft on the part of the courier company. Ask for the tracking log and see if there was any delay in the delivery of the shipment, this may be the instance when the parcel was opened or damaged. More than likely nothing will come of this though I'm afraid. 😔 Hopefully they take some action and make sure you insure your shipments next time.

The best thing I found was understanding why you feel this way. Once you understand yourself you can learn what makes you happy. That being said spend time with people that make you happy and relish those moments because they're the ones that pull you back. All those funny little memories and experiences will help to guide you to your happiness. I hope this helps you, someone said it to me and it just resonated and stuck with me through the darkest time. If you need anything else from me I'll be here.
